items.exampleEn: My shoes are under the table.
I have a lot of friends.
Both of my parents are teachers.
There are tall trees around the house.
The beach is ten minutes away.
The shop is open until nine.
I have not finished my homework yet.

items.sentenceEn: Are you a student? Yes, I am.

items.audioEn: Is the shop open? Yes, it is open until ten.

items.sentenceEn: There are a lot of books under the bed.

items.stemEn: I have two brothers. ____ of them are tall.
items.stemZh: 我有兩個兄弟，他們兩個都很高。

items.passageEn: Lisa has a dog and a cat. Both of them sleep under her bed. Every evening, she walks the dog around the block. Her cat stays home. Lisa says the cat is not ready for a walk yet. They walk until it gets dark.
items.passageZh: Lisa 有一隻狗和一隻貓，牠們都睡在她的床底下。每天傍晚，她都帶狗繞著街區散步，貓則待在家裡。Lisa 說貓還沒準備好去散步。她和狗一直走到天黑。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 的狗和貓睡在哪裡？
Lisa 每天傍晚帶狗做什麼？

rubricZh: 「兩個都」可用 both，放在 be 動詞後面（例如 We are both）或主詞前（例如 Both of us）
主詞是複數，名詞也用複數 students

referenceEn: This city has a lot of parks.
There are a lot of parks in this city.
rubricZh: a lot of 後面接複數名詞（例如 a lot of parks）；寫 lots of、many 也正確
可寫，例如 This city has…、There are … in this city 等
